mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET READ_COUNT = READ_COUNT + 1 WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
UPDATE BOARD SET STATUS = 'n' WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD(TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER) VALUES(#{title}, #{content}, #{writer})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM REPLY WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND STATUS = 'y' ORDER BY NVL(PARENT_ID, COMMENT_ID), COMMENT_ID
